definitions.explanation: A medical device used to deliver medication directly into the lungs through inhalation. Commonly used for asthma and respiratory conditions. Composed of 吸入 (inhalation) and 器 (device).

examples.japanese: {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}い{込|こ}む→吸い込む：06984_suikomu⟧。
examples.english: I inhale medication using an inhaler.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧{持|も}ちな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{吸入器|きゅうにゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧。
examples.english: I have asthma, so I always carry an inhaler with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{吸入器|きゅうにゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor prescribed a new inhaler for me.

notes:
USAGE:
{吸入器|きゅうにゅうき} is a general medical term covering both handheld inhalers and larger nebulizer devices. For the specific handheld type, {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき} is the standard term used by doctors and patients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use an inhaler)
- {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prescribe an inhaler)
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧{吸入器|きゅうにゅうき} (portable inhaler)

SIMILAR WORDS:
ネブライザー is the loanword for "nebulizer," referring specifically to the mist-generating type. {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき} is broader and covers all types of inhalation devices.
